links.comparator_used: Default chatbot outputs with no reading-level instruction, compared with the same chatbots' outputs after being asked to simplify to a sixth-grade reading level
links.outcome: Readability grade level of chatbot-generated kidney cancer patient education text
links.effect: Default mean readability: ChatGPT-4.0 11.03 ± 1.76, Gemini AI 10.83 ± 2.31, Perplexity AI 12.66 ± 1.83. After the simplification request: ChatGPT-4.0 5.76 to 9.19, Perplexity AI 7.33 to 8.45, Gemini AI 6.43 to 8.43.
links.tradeoff: Most simplified outputs still did not reach the sixth-grade target. The study also reports that LLM outputs in general are prone to detail omission and some inaccuracies, but it does not separately assess the simplified versions.
links.quote: The Chatbots demonstrated the capability to simplify text lower grade levels upon request, with ChatGPT-4.0 achieving a readability grade level ranging from 5.76 to 9.19, Perplexity AI from 7.33 to 8.45, Gemini AI from 6.43 to 8.43.

design_hint: reading-level constraint (prompting chatbots to simplify to sixth-grade level)
